verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a sub-workflow or Execute Workflow capability that lets one workflow call another as a reusable module. Error workflows (a separate workflow triggered on failure) and Webhook or MCP Server Trigger nodes are related features, not composable sub-workflows, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to a workflow-automation builder, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
